title: ProjectPolicy
description: T07 design note §5.9 and §10.3, ADR 0019 D4. `project-policy.json`: the capability grants of one project, its executor settings, once declared its ambient pressure (ADR 0075 D6) and, once switched on, in-band administration (ADR 0078 D5.1). It changes only through audited operator commands, and an invalid file is refused rather than defaulted: a grant must validate before it can confer authority. `capability_id` and every non-null `token_sha256` are unique across `capabilities`; a JSON Schema cannot state either, and `ProjectPolicy.from_document` does.

ambient_pressure.description: ADR 0075 D6: the project's declared ambient pressure, Pa, absolute. Read only by the gauge display rows (`barg`, `psig`) of `display-conversion-v1`; never by a run, a binding, a certificate, a cache key or a replay. Absent until declared with `openflowsheet project ambient`; never assumed.

administration.description: ADR 0078 D5.1: the operator's switch for in-band policy administration (`get_policy` reads in any case; `grant_capability`, `revoke_capability` and `set_ambient_pressure` need it). Present only as `{in_band: true}`, set and removed with `openflowsheet project administration on|off`; absent means off, so a policy written before X06 keeps its bytes and its `policy_sha256`.
